entries.title: Trenches quick-buy: one button per card, and fills that actually stick.
entries.text: Two live reports from the Trenches screener, both fixed:

- **Every card showed TWO quick-buy buttons.** The site redesigned its card   layout; two of its link anchors now climb to different containers that both   look like "the row" to our scanner, and each got its own chip. Chips are now   deduplicated per card — one button, one buy, no twins.

- **Buy from the list, open the chart, and your line/bubbles/position were   missing.** Each quick-buy opens the coin's chart in a background tab by   design — and with several PaperTrench tabs alive, the wallet's write race   could starve a fresh fill on all its retries and silently drop it: the buy   happened, the toast fired, but nothing reached the chart. A fill now lands   with a final forced write instead of ever being dropped, and the losing   background writes no longer surface as page errors.
